# Connected2Country

> Consultant anthropologist and archaeologist (Helen Haritos) based in Darwin, Northern Territory, Australia. Provides Traditional Owner and Native Title holder consultation, AAPA Authority Certificate support and sacred site advice, cultural heritage and cultural values assessments, Cultural Heritage Management Plans and CEMP heritage sections, native title and anthropological research and expert reports, cultural awareness inductions and ceremony facilitation, and AI/digital services for cultural heritage including Indigenous Data Sovereignty advice. Over 20 years in NT Aboriginal land, heritage and native title work, including senior anthropologist roles with the Northern Land Council and Tiwi Land Council. Phone 0438 805 294. Email helen@connected2country.au. ABN 23 319 539 776.

Service regions in priority order: (1) Darwin, Palmerston and the Litchfield rural area (Larrakia country); (2) the Top End including Katherine, Kakadu, Arnhem Land, the Tiwi Islands and the Daly; (3) the wider Northern Territory and the East Kimberley region of Western Australia (Kununurra, Wyndham, Halls Creek).

## Services
- [Traditional Owner and Native Title holder consultation](https://connected2country.au/services/traditional-owner-consultation/): Anthropologist-led consultation with Larrakia and other Traditional Owners for developments in Darwin, Palmerston and the Top End. Right people, proper process, defensible consent records for your approval.
- [AAPA Authority Certificate support and sacred site advice](https://connected2country.au/services/aapa-authority-certificate-sacred-sites/): Help obtaining and complying with Aboriginal Areas Protection Authority (AAPA) Authority Certificates in the NT: applications, custodian consultation, restricted work area interpretation and construction compliance.
- [Cultural heritage and cultural values assessments](https://connected2country.au/services/cultural-heritage-assessment/): Ethnographic and cultural values assessments, Heritage Act 2011 advice and EIS culture and heritage chapters for projects in Darwin, the Top End and the NT, prepared by an anthropologist and archaeologist.
- [Cultural Heritage Management Plans and CEMP heritage sections](https://connected2country.au/services/cultural-heritage-management-plans/): Project-specific Cultural Heritage Management Plans (CHMPs) and the cultural heritage sections of Construction Environmental Management Plans for NT civil and development projects, with inductions, monitoring and inspections.
- [Anthropological research, native title support and expert reports](https://connected2country.au/services/anthropological-research-expert-reports/): Consultant anthropologist for native title and land claim research, genealogies, connection reports, land council and ALRA matters and expert reports in the Northern Territory and East Kimberley.
- [Cultural awareness training, heritage inductions and ceremony facilitation](https://connected2country.au/services/cultural-awareness-inductions/): Project-specific cultural awareness sessions, sacred site and heritage inductions for construction crews, and facilitation of Welcome to Country and smoking ceremonies with Traditional Owners in Darwin and the Top End.
- [AI and digital services for cultural heritage](https://connected2country.au/services/ai-digital-cultural-heritage/): Responsible use of AI and digital tools in cultural heritage: AI-assisted desktop assessments and research, secure cultural knowledge recording and archives, and Indigenous Data Sovereignty advice for Traditional Owner groups and proponents in the NT.

## Regions
- [Traditional Owner consultation and cultural heritage in Darwin, Palmerston and the rural area](https://connected2country.au/regions/darwin-palmerston-rural/): Darwin-based anthropologist for Traditional Owner consultation, AAPA Authority Certificate support and cultural heritage assessment across Darwin, Palmerston, Litchfield and the rural area on Larrakia and neighbouring country.
- [Traditional Owner consultation and cultural heritage across the Top End](https://connected2country.au/regions/top-end/): Anthropological services across the Top End: Katherine, Kakadu and West Arnhem, Arnhem Land, the Tiwi Islands, the Daly River and the Victoria River District. Land council experience, remote-capable, Wet-season aware.
- [Anthropological services across the Northern Territory and into the East Kimberley](https://connected2country.au/regions/northern-territory-kimberley/): Consultant anthropologist available Territory-wide, including Central Australia, and across the border into the East Kimberley of Western Australia: Kununurra, Wyndham, Lake Argyle and Halls Creek. Aboriginal Heritage Act 1972 (WA) and NT frameworks.

## Guides
- [What is an AAPA Authority Certificate and do I need one?](https://connected2country.au/guides/what-is-an-aapa-authority-certificate/): How Authority Certificates under the NT Aboriginal Sacred Sites Act work, when a Darwin or Top End project should apply, what it costs in time, and how to avoid the common mistakes.
- [Do I need Traditional Owner consultation for my Darwin development?](https://connected2country.au/guides/traditional-owner-consultation-darwin-development/): Which Darwin, Palmerston and rural area projects need Traditional Owner consultation, which approvals expect it, who the Larrakia Traditional Owners are, and how to do it properly.
- [NT heritage laws explained: Sacred Sites Act, Heritage Act and the Land Rights Act](https://connected2country.au/guides/nt-heritage-laws-explained/): A plain-English guide to the three laws that govern Aboriginal cultural heritage in the Northern Territory, who administers each, and how they interact on a typical project.
- [AI in cultural heritage work: what changes and what does not](https://connected2country.au/guides/ai-in-cultural-heritage-what-changes/): How AI is changing heritage research, documentation and compliance, where it helps, where it is risky, and the questions Traditional Owner organisations and proponents should be asking.
